text:
mira: Quick note — sampleapp gets UI jank when firing ~20 parallel requests on emulator (Pixel API 31). Lots of OkHttp retry logs and socket reuse warnings.

devon: Interesting. Emulator-only or seen on devices? Can you paste the minimal client config?

mira: Config:
val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .connectionPool(ConnectionPool(5, 5, TimeUnit.MINUTES))
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(true)
  .dispatcher(Dispatcher().apply { maxRequests = 64; maxRequestsPerHost = 5 })
  .build()

Log: 
W/OkHttp: A connection to http://10.0.2.2/ was leaked. Did you forget to close a response body?
E/Network: java.net.SocketTimeoutException: Read timed out
I/ConnPool: Releasing connection for route /10.0.2.2

qa-bot: Reproduced on Pixel 5 emulator (API 31). adb logcat shows ConnectionPool evict then reuse cycles and frequent Read timed out.

samir: Hypothesis: emulator network virtualization + HTTP/2 multiplexing causing partial frame drops -> OkHttp reuses streams and hits timeouts. Quick checks: set retryOnConnectionFailure(false), try ConnectionPool(0,1,MS) or force HTTP/1.1 via protocols(listOf(Protocol.HTTP_1_1)). Also try lowering Dispatcher.maxRequestsPerHost to 2 to reduce concurrency.

mira: Tried dispatcher=2 -> UI smoother but lower throughput. ConnectionPool(0,1ms) removes leak logs but CPU spikes. Disabling HTTP/2 (HTTP/1.1) eliminated most read timeouts on emulator. Physical device not affected.

devon: Sounds like an emulator quirk. Action items: surface emulator-friendly defaults in sampleapp, add a Troubleshooting section (mention protocols workaround), expose Dispatcher/ConnectionPool knobs, and add a test matrix row for HTTP/2 vs HTTP/1.1 on emulator vs device.

docsmith: Can we also add a tiny repro harness that fires N concurrent requests in CI so we catch regressions?

mira: I'll open a PR to update sampleapp: detect emulator runtime and set conservative Dispatcher + disable HTTP/2 there, add troubleshooting note, and include the harness.

devon: Great — file an issue and assign. Thanks! :thumbsup:
